title: [2.8.2] Failed meal bolus queued and administered along with the reentered one
body:
AAPS 2.8.2 + Accu-Chek Combo

While using the Bolus Wizard the SMB was administered and it caused the meal bolus to fail. The caretaker checked the pump for bolus history and the last one was 0,1u, so she reentered the meal and AAPS did send both meal boluses to the pump.

Queuing of the failing meal bolus (instead of leaving the progress bar in focus or actually removing the bolus from the queue) looks like a terrible design decision.

SMB - 0,1u
1st meal bolus - 1,4u
2nd meal bolus - 1,3u

Started around 13:43:21:
[AndroidAPS._2021-11-08_00-00-00_.14.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7537394/AndroidAPS._2021-11-08_00-00-00_.14.zip)

from what i see AAPS behavior was correct
first attempt of 2nd bolus was refused because previous bolus was still running
second attempt of 2nd bolus was executed because it was after finish of 1st bolus
@MilosKozak Thanks for checking - it seems the situation was described to us differently.
On the other hand why the 1.4 bolus dialog disappeared from the screen allowing to enter the meal 2nd time?
it can be problem described by andy. it will be improved in 3.0
